title: A finite surjective disjoint union of open immersions has a section
statement: Let $Z$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and let $p:V\to Z$ be a finite [def-weil-finite-integral-morphism] surjective [def-weil-surjective-morphism] morphism. Suppose that $V=\coprod_{i=1}^nV_i$ is a finite disjoint union of open and closed subschemes such that every restriction $p_i:V_i\to Z$ is an open immersion [def-weil-open-immersion]. Then $p$ has a section $s:Z\to V$ with $p\circ s=\mathrm{id}_Z$.

source.place: Lemma 59.80.6 (Tag 09ZA), proof, final paragraph: the finite cover by open-and-closed images is refined to disjoint clopen strata and the inverse open immersions glue to a section

proof.text: *The images are open, closed and cover $Z$ (Stacks: 'As $V\to Z$ is finite we see that $V_i\to Z$ is also closed. Let $U_i\subset Z$ be the image').* For $i=1,\dots,n$ let $k_i:V_i\to V$ be the inclusion of the open subscheme $V_i$, so that $p_i=p\circ k_i$, and let $U_i=p(V_i)=p_i(V_i)\subseteq Z$. Since $p_i$ is an open immersion, $U_i$ is open in $Z$ [def-weil-open-immersion]. Since $p$ is finite it is a closed map (part (1) of [lem-weil-pbc-finite-closed-map-finite-fibres]), and $V_i$ is closed in $V$, so $U_i=p(V_i)$ is closed in $Z$. Since $p$ is surjective [def-weil-surjective-morphism], every $z\in Z$ is $p(v)$ for some $v\in V=\bigcup_iV_i$, say $v\in V_i$, and then $z\in U_i$; so $Z=U_1\cup\dots\cup U_n$.

*The strata (Stacks: the decomposition $Z=\coprod_{(A,B)} igcap_{i\in A}U_i\cap igcap_{i\in B}U_i^c$ over $\{1,\dots,n\}=A\amalg B$ with $A
eq\emptyset$; 'each of the strata is contained in a single $U_i$').* For a nonempty subset $A\subseteq\{1,\dots,n\}$ put $Z_A= igcap_{i\in A}U_i\cap igcap_{i
otin A}(Z\setminus U_i)$. Each $U_i$ and each $Z\setminus U_i$ is open and closed in $Z$ (step 1), so $Z_A$, a finite intersection of open and closed subsets, is open and closed. For $z\in Z$ let $A(z)=\{i: z\in U_i\}$, which is nonempty by step 1; by definition $z\in Z_A$ if and only if $A=A(z)$. Hence the $Z_A$ ($A
eq\emptyset$) are pairwise disjoint and cover $Z$. Put $i(A)=\min A$; then $Z_A\subseteq U_{i(A)}$. (Some $Z_A$ may be empty; nothing below needs them nonempty.)

*The section on one stratum (Stacks: 'we find our section').* Fix $A\neq\emptyset$, write $i=i(A)$, and let $j_{Z_A}:Z_A\to Z$ and $j_{U_i}:U_i\to Z$ be the inclusions of the open subschemes on $Z_A$ and $U_i$ (step 1, step 2) [def-pc-scheme]. By [lem-weil-pbc-open-immersion-iso-onto-image] applied to the open immersion $p_i:V_i\to Z$, whose image is $U_i$, there is an isomorphism $\varphi_i:V_i\to U_i$ with $j_{U_i}\circ\varphi_i=p_i$. Since $j_{Z_A}(Z_A)=Z_A\subseteq U_i$, [lem-weil-pbc-morphism-factors-through-open-subscheme] gives a morphism $\iota_A:Z_A\to U_i$ with $j_{U_i}\circ\iota_A=j_{Z_A}$. Put $s_A=k_i\circ\varphi_i^{-1}\circ\iota_A:Z_A\to V$. Then $p\circ s_A=p_i\circ\varphi_i^{-1}\circ\iota_A=j_{U_i}\circ\varphi_i\circ\varphi_i^{-1}\circ\iota_A=j_{U_i}\circ\iota_A=j_{Z_A}$.

*Gluing the local sections.* By step 2 the open subschemes $Z_A$, $A$ running over the nonempty subsets of $\{1,\dots,n\}$, form an open covering of $Z$. The morphisms $s_A:Z_A\to V$ of step 3 agree on overlaps: for $A\neq B$ the overlap $Z_A\cap Z_B$ is empty (step 2), and a scheme with empty underlying space has exactly one morphism to $V$ (the empty map of spaces, and on structure sheaves the map to $\mathcal O_{\emptyset}(\emptyset)=0$, the zero ring), so $s_A$ and $s_B$ restrict to the same morphism there; for $A=B$ there is nothing to check. By [lem-weil-pbc-scheme-morphism-gluing] there is a morphism $s:Z\to V$ with $s\circ j_{Z_A}=s_A$ for every $A$. Then for every $A$, $(p\circ s)\circ j_{Z_A}=p\circ s_A=j_{Z_A}=\mathrm{id}_Z\circ j_{Z_A}$ (step 3), so $p\circ s$ and $\mathrm{id}_Z$ have the same restriction to every member of the covering, and by the uniqueness clause of [lem-weil-pbc-scheme-morphism-gluing] $p\circ s=\mathrm{id}_Z$: $s$ is a section of $p$.

split_report.summary: Split along the second paragraph of the proof of Stacks 09ZA (etale-cohomology.tex line 14390, label checked in tags/tags). Four steps: (1) the images U_i=p(V_i) are open (open immersion), closed (p finite hence a closed map, existing leaf lem-weil-pbc-finite-closed-map-finite-fibres (1)) and cover Z (p surjective); (2) the Stacks strata Z_A = ∩_{i∈A}U_i ∩ ∩_{i∉A}U_i^c, A nonempty, are open and closed, pairwise disjoint, cover Z, and Z_A ⊆ U_{min A} (elementary); (3) on Z_A the section k_i∘φ_i^{-1}∘ι_A with φ_i: V_i ≅ U_i from the new Mathlib leaf lem-weil-pbc-open-immersion-iso-onto-image (Stacks 01HH; Scheme.Hom.isoOpensRange) and ι_A from lem-weil-pbc-morphism-factors-through-open-subscheme; (4) gluing over the open cover {Z_A} (overlaps empty) by the leaf lem-weil-pbc-scheme-morphism-gluing (unit sk-thm-reduction, a Mathlib leaf hence a tool), whose uniqueness clause gives p∘s=id_Z. Statement unchanged; finiteness is used only for closedness of the images. lean.statement: theorem exists_section_of_finite_clopen_open_cover {n : ℕ} (Z V : Scheme.{u}) (p : V ⟶ Z) [IsFinite p] [Surjective p] (Vi : Fin n → Scheme.{u}) (k : ∀ i, Vi i ⟶ V) (hk : ∀ i, IsOpenImmersion (k i) ∧ IsClosedImmersion (k i)) (hcop : IsColimit (Cofan.mk V k)) (pi : ∀ i, Vi i ⟶ Z) (hpi : ∀ i, pi i = k i ≫ p) [∀ i, IsOpenImmersion (pi i)] : ∃ s : Z ⟶ V, s ≫ p = 𝟙 Z
